name: Covert Entry Operations
description: Ability to plan and execute covert physical entry operations as part of authorised security assessments. Covers entry planning, route selection, timing, alarm system awareness, evidence of entry minimisation, objective execution (device placement, document photography), and safe exfiltration. Integrates lock picking, access control bypass, and social engineering skills into cohesive physical operations.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to covert entry operations

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concept of covert entry and key operational considerations
evidence: Completed covert entry operations awareness training
Can describe the phases of a covert entry operation (recon, planning, entry, objective, exfil)
Understands the importance of minimising evidence of entry and alarm awareness

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Participates in covert entry operations under close supervision
evidence: Participated in supervised covert entry exercises in lab or training environments
Assisted with specific tasks (lookout, lock defeat, device placement) under team lead direction
Understands alarm system types and their implications for entry operations

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Plans and executes covert entry operations for standard commercial targets
evidence: Planned and executed covert entry on 3+ authorised physical penetration tests
Selected entry routes and timing based on surveillance and site reconnaissance
Completed objectives (device placement, evidence collection) without detection
Briefed the team on abort criteria, emergency contacts and the challenge procedure before each entry attempt
Maintained detailed operational logs and evidence for engagement reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Executes complex covert entry against secured facilities; leads multi-person operations
evidence: Led covert entry operations against targets with security guards, CCTV, and alarm systems
Coordinated multi-person entry teams with clear roles and communications
Adapted entry plans in real-time when encountering unexpected security controls
Mentors team on covert entry planning and execution

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines covert entry methodology; handles the most sensitive operations; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's covert entry operations methodology and safety protocols
Executed high-sensitivity covert entry operations for regulated engagements
Develops training scenarios and exercises for covert entry skill development
Recognised as the lab's authority on physical covert entry operations

assessment_methods.description: Plan and execute a covert entry operation against a lab-prepared facility with defined objectives, security controls, and time constraints
Shadow the operator during a live physical penetration test, assessing planning, execution, adaptability, and evidence collection
